checks.name: budget_and_hash
checks.result: cargo test --locked -p awr-context --test budget: 5/5. Whole required facts, exact total text counting, boundary rejection, larger optional omission with smaller later fit, stable priority/recency selection, set/object ordering stability, source/entity conflicts and project/work/branch/source/request/rendered-content hash bindings.

checks.name: hard_context_and_bootstrap
checks.result: awr-context hard_context 3/3 and awr-cli bootstrap_cli 3/3. More than 50KB of exact acceptance, multiline blocker/next action and all scoped hard rules survive sufficient budget; too-small budgets fail without truncation. Shared token counting preserves bootstrap behavior.

checks.name: workspace_build
checks.result: cargo build --locked --workspace and --workspace --examples passed; git diff --check passed.

checks.name: actual_project_budget
checks.result: At revision 143, repeated current-project budget previews returned identical text/hash: 1603 tokens including optional information, 1542 required tokens. A 1542 budget retained five hard rules and two exact acceptance conditions, omitting one optional information chunk. A 1000 budget failed with empty stdout and required=1542. Checkpoint/session closure and doctor completed.

acceptance.criterion: 预算估计器有明确算法和误差说明，排序及截取规则确定。
hash 绑定项目/任务/来源版本、分支、选中实体及渲染内容；硬事实超限明确失败。

limitations: Budget API and hard-subset preview only. L1 must classify and supply all additional mandatory facts; this output is not whole-context admission. Token count is rendered text under o200k_base, excluding JSON/tool framing/conversation and other tokenizer differences. System benchmarks, 20x compression, 1000-token L0 admission and real-client E4 remain uncompleted.
